question.problem:
Consider the following matrices:

$$
{B}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}],\,{B}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,A=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 9 \\ -2 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$

If $B=\{{B}_{1},{B}_{2}\}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}\{{B}_{1},{B}_{2}\},$ and $[A]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}],$ then $2{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
{x}_{1}{B}_{1}+{x}_{2}{B}_{2}=A.
$$

Substituting the given information into the above equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 9 \\ -2 & 5\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} & 3{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{1} & {x}_{1}+{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 9 \\ -2 & 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding entries, we obtain

$$
\{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}=-2 \\ 3{x}_{2}=9 \\ -{x}_{1}=-2 \\ {x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=5.\end{aligned}
$$

 

The equations above give a linear system with the augmented matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 & 9 \\ -1 & 0 & -2 \\ 1 & 1 & 5\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the matrix using Gaussian elimination, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}2 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 & 9 \\ -1 & 0 & -2 \\ 1 & 1 & 5\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{1}↔{R}_{4}\end{aligned} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 3 & 9 \\ -1 & 0 & -2 \\ 2 & -2 & -2\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+{R}_{1} \\ {R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+(-2){R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 3 & 9 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & -4 & -12\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=5 \\ 3{x}_{2}=9 \\ {x}_{2}=3 \\ -4{x}_{2}=-12.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second,  third and fourth equations, we get ${x}_{2}=3.$ From the first equation, we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+3 & =5 \\ {x}_{1} & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, $[A]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3\end{aligned}].$

Finally, $2{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=2\cdot 2+3=7.$
